meta.title: Sats Safari
meta.taglineSub: Play seven short stops. Earn stars.

menu.made: Made by Stanley in Kisumu, Kenya.
menu.pretend: Everything here is pretend. No real money.

map.title: Your safari map
map.subtitle: Finish each stop to open the next one.
map.comingSoon: This stop is still being built. Come back soon.

3.name: Send It On
3.line: Pass sats along. No double spend.

7.name: Only 21 Million
7.line: New coins slow down to a stop.

l1.countLine: Tap every coin and count along.
l1.fillLine: Tap 10 times. Each tap adds 10,000,000 sats.
l1.shopLine: A mango costs {price} sats. You hold {wallet} sats. Put the exact coins on the till.
l1.hintShop: The mango is 500. Five 100 coins do it.
l1.a: One bitcoin splits into 100,000,000 tiny coins called sats. Each one passes from owner to owner.
l1.b: Small things cost a few sats. Nobody needs a whole bitcoin.

l2.openLine: Only your secret key opens it. Nobody else holds one.
l2.opened: Open! Your sats are safe inside.
l2.foxLine: “Show me your secret key!” says the fox.
l2.kept: Well kept! Your sats stay yours.
l2.shown: Never! Nobody may see your secret key. Not even a friendly fox.
l2.addrLine: Amina wants to send you sats. What do you give her?
l2.addrGood: The address only receives. Coins arrive!
l2.addrBad: No! The secret key opens your coins. Never share it.
l2.hintAddr: Share the address. Hide the key.
l2.a: The secret key opens your coins. Never show it to anyone.
l2.b: The public address only receives. Sharing it is safe.

l3.sendLine: Tap Aza's address, then sign with your secret key.
l3.wrongAddr: That is Juma. Aza is waiting.
l3.backLine: “Thank you!” Now send sats to Juma.
l3.refused: Refused! You have {have}. Every friend's list says so.
l3.a: A transaction moves sats from one address to another.
l3.b: The same sats can only be spent once. Everyone checks.

l4.packLine: Tap each transaction to load it on the train.
l4.linked: Linked! Each block holds the last fingerprint.
l4.tamperLine: Now tap block 1. Change one old letter.
l4.broke: The links broke! One changed letter breaks every link after it.
l4.a: Transactions ride together in a block.
l4.b: Each block holds the last block's fingerprint. Change one letter and the links break.

l5.tapLine: Each tap tries the next number. The hash must start with a zero.
l5.autoLine: Two zeros are 16 times harder. Let the machine drill.
l5.wrongFast: Too fast means harder, not easier.
l5.wrongSlow: Too slow means easier, not harder.
l5.tenMin: Real Bitcoin aims for 10 minutes a block.
l5.a: Mining is guessing numbers until the hash starts with zeros.
l5.b: Too fast? Harder. Too slow? Easier. About 10 minutes a block.

l6.longLine: Count the blocks. Tap the tallest pile.
l6.countAgain: Count again. Whose pile is tallest?
l6.disqualified: Right! A broken link disqualifies it.
l6.lookClose: Look closely. One block carries a cross.
l6.winLine: Mosi is out. Tap the longest valid pile.
l6.shorter: Shorter. The longest valid pile wins.
l6.hintWinner: Aza and Juma tie. Either wins.
l6.bossLine: “I am the boss! Use MY short list!”
l6.noBoss: Nobody is the boss. Friends follow the longest valid list.
l6.a: Every friend keeps the same list of blocks.
l6.b: The longest valid list wins. Nobody is the boss.

l7.capTitle: How many can there EVER be?
l7.capLine: Four seasons passed. The gifts keep halving.
l7.capWrong: Look at the shrinking gifts. Try again.
l7.nextLine: This season gave 6.25. What comes next?
l7.a: New coins halve about every 4 years: 50, 25, 12.5…
l7.b: Never more than 21 million. Then miners earn fees.

parents.title: For parents and teachers
parents.intro: Sats Safari teaches children how Bitcoin works by playing. Seven short stops. About 20 minutes.
parents.offline: Open the game once with internet. After that it plays without internet. Progress stays on this device.
parents.data1: The game itself: nothing. Stars, badges, language and sound stay in this browser.
parents.data2: The site counts the visit on its own server: the day, the page, the referring site, and the utm_source tag if the link carries one. No IP address, no cookie, no user agent.
parents.data3: If the page script lock blocks something, the browser sends the Security watch a short report: the page, the rule and the blocked address.
parents.safety: Everything is pretend. No real money, no wallets, no accounts, no chat, no ads.
